sn45.76:1.1: Accomplishment in careful attention … complete as in §70 …
sn45.76:1.4: He develops right concentration, which has as its final goal the removal of lust, the removal of hatred, the removal of delusion.
sn45.76:1.5: It is in this way, bhikkhus, that a bhikkhu who is accomplished in careful attention develops and cultivates the Noble Eightfold Path.”
